agritech.marketplace.hero.title: Uzbekistan's entire agro market — on one platform
agritech.marketplace.hero.subtitle: Seeds, equipment and harvest directly from verified farms. Compare current offers without middlemen.
agritech.marketplace.demo.title: Demo reviewer accounts
agritech.marketplace.demo.description: These labelled preview listings are supplied by the DehqonHub API. Browse and bookmark them locally; commercial actions stay disabled.
agritech.marketplace.how.title: How purchase requests work
agritech.marketplace.how.step1Desc: Tell us what you need and set a budget.
agritech.marketplace.how.step2Desc: Eligible sellers may send offers with price and delivery terms.
agritech.marketplace.how.step3Desc: Choose an offer, then review the current transaction and contract terms.
agritech.marketplace.how.description: A purchase request collects seller offers; choosing one creates terms for review, not a completed payment.
agritech.marketplace.demo.checkoutDone: Order assembled in this browser. Sign in to sign a contract.
agritech.marketplace.demo.guest: You are browsing without an account. Favourites and your cart stay in this browser — sign in to place an order, or use one of the test accounts below.
agritech.marketplace.demo.prepared: A purchase request with competing offers and a signed contract are already prepared between the buyer and the seller account — sign in as either one to open them under purchase requests and contracts.
agritech.marketplace.demo.purpose.buyer: Creates purchase requests, compares incoming offers and signs contracts as the buyer. This account only buys.
agritech.marketplace.demo.purpose.farmer: Buys everything and sells everything: it owns the co-operative that lists produce, and its farm dashboard covers fields, samples and agronomy advice.
agritech.marketplace.demo.purpose.seller: Publishes listings, answers purchase requests with offers and signs contracts as the seller. This account only sells.
agritech.marketplace.demo.reviewerNotice: These three identities come from the guarded demo seed and are published on purpose so a reviewer can sign in as each role. They are demo accounts, not real users, and nothing they show is production activity.
agritech.marketplace.demo.role.buyer: Buyer — buys only: requests, cart and contracts
agritech.marketplace.demo.role.seller: Seller — sells only: listings and offers
agritech.marketplace.demo.signInRequired: Sign in to complete this action. Any of the test accounts will do.
agritech.marketplace.demo.unavailable: The catalog is unreachable right now. Try again in a moment, or sign in with a test account below.
